title: [DEV] Medtrum: Unable to set Timezone > GMT + 13 on pump
body:
Builds affected: Any build with medtrum driver
Logs: Not needed, can be easily reproduced

Working on a fix right now, issue is for tracability. New Zealand users seem affacted

How to reproduce:
Switch to any timezone that has a offset larger then GMT + 13

comments.body: Need to check TDD from pump after this fix, will leave this issue open for now

Some wierdness in TDD from pump the day after timezone change, but this is to be expected anyway and is unavoidable this way.
After 2 days TDD from pump seems normal
